## PDF styling and restored sea freight

- Give application-generated documents a consistent EMCargo layout with Cal Sans
  headings, blue accents and calm, readable tables. Long goods lists, addresses
  and annual-report answers continue cleanly across pages.
- Display IMDG substances in labelled blocks that retain all ten fields.
- Restore sea freight throughout navigation, shipment intake and saved shipments.
- Keep installation branding, official form layouts and printed label dimensions.
- Use the shared styling for newly generated UN cards; installed card sets change
  only when a new set is imported.

This release includes the changes from 2.12.0 through 2.12.3. Application release
automation resumes with advisory license reports and required technical checks.

## Updating

Docker images are available for both `linux/amd64` and `linux/arm64`:

```text
ghcr.io/jeffreymooiweer/emcargo:2.12.3
ghcr.io/jeffreymooiweer/emcargo:v2.12.3
ghcr.io/jeffreymooiweer/emcargo:latest
```

The native installation bundle and its SHA-256 checksum are attached below.
Compatible official form templates from existing installations are preserved by
the supported Docker/native upgrade paths. New installations import their own
originals through Administration → Document templates.

The production runtime no longer includes PyMuPDF. Document validation, IMDG
source assessment and DG Specialist release continue to apply.
